faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions?
faq.q1: What files do I need to send?
faq.a1: At minimum: your raw vocal recording (WAV preferred) and the beat/instrumental. If you have stems, even better!
faq.a2: Standard delivery is 2-3 business days. Rush delivery (24-48 hours) is available for +€30.
faq.a3: One revision is included. Additional revisions are €15 each.
faq.q4: Can you mix tracks recorded elsewhere?
faq.a4: Absolutely! As long as the recordings are decent quality, I can work with them.
faq.a5: Yes! For EP/album projects (5+ tracks), I offer 15% off.
faq.q6: What do I get when it is done?
faq.a6: You receive the final mix in WAV + MP3 formats. Ready for Spotify, Apple Music, etc.
